critic.reason: Semantics-preserving and in-scope. The patch hoists the loop-invariant load get_int_b2(bq5_0->qh, 0) out of the unrolled VDR_Q5_0_Q8_1_MMVQ loop in vec_dot_q5_0_q8_1; because the source address is fixed, the pointer is __restrict__, and there are no intervening stores, vh[i] values and the inputs to vec_dot_q5_0_q8_1_impl are bit-identical, so correctness is preserved by construction. Governance checks pass: single reviewed file within cuda-vecdotq-v1 allowed symbols; change_class arithmetic matches template authority and the akh-v2-q5-type-specific-dequant data-reuse mechanism; no wave-count or launch-geometry mutation, so no overlap with dnr-q5-four-wave or any other DNR fingerprint. Expected dispatch declares exactly the three sealed type-6 true/true anchors (6063@57344, 4644@8192, 3096@311296; workgroup 128, LDS 1024) and correctly excludes the 129-call false/true tail. cold_serialized load mode is the only admissible mode under the fallback-only admission corpus. Caveat: the HIP compiler almost certainly already CSEs this redundant load in the force-inlined, fully unrolled body, so the ISA delta and measured effect may be near zero; this is an expected-value concern, not a compliance defect, and the declared falsifier (exact type-6 kernel duration does not improve under correctness-preserving replay) plus the 0.5% nomination floor will resolve it cheaply within the 3-candidate budget.
